name: Genyouritsu Raimu
source:
A girl who can transform and fight. She lived with her father, a scientist.
Bright and active, she is also proactive. She came to Earth in pursuit of Kirazaki.

[From [url=https://s-digi.jp/lilim/02_soft/01_lilim/22_raimu/01-e.html] Official site[/url]]
